vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: nginx-config
Version: 2.3.0

The skill is a legitimate Nginx configuration generator that provides templates for reverse proxies, SSL/HTTPS, static file serving, and security hardening. The core logic in `scripts/nginx.sh` safely interpolates user-provided parameters into configuration strings and outputs them to stdout without executing them or performing any unauthorized system modifications or data exfiltration.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction+script package that generates nginx configuration templates and does not request credentials, install software, or perform unexpected network/file access in the provided content.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (nginx config generation: reverse proxy, SSL, caching, security, optimization) match the included instructions and the bash generator script which produces nginx config snippets and templates. The requested resources (none) are appropriate for this purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and the script only describe/generate nginx configuration and provide usage/comments (e.g., suggestion to run certbot). The runtime instructions and script do not instruct reading unrelated files, accessing credentials, contacting external endpoints, or exfiltrating data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install specification is provided (instruction-only plus a script). Nothing is downloaded or written by an installer; risk from install mechanism is low.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths. The script references standard server paths (e.g., /etc/letsencrypt/live, /var/log/nginx) only in generated output — it does not read or write them — so requested environment access is proportional.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request persistent system privileges. There is no code that modifies other skills or system-wide configs; it's a generator intended for on-demand invocation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to simply generate nginx configuration templates and does not ask for secrets or perform network/file operations in the shown files. Before applying any generated config to production: review the generated config line-by-line, test it in a staging environment, and validate any paths (logs, cert locations) and proxy/backend addresses. Note: the provided script output references common system paths (e.g., /etc/letsencrypt/live); the script itself does not modify or read those files in the visible portion, but you should review the full script (the listing was partially truncated) to confirm there are no hidden operations before running it with elevated privileges.
